_help: Regression tests are run by `ba.py regression-run` against the ORIGINAL code and must fail (exit code in expected_failure_exit_codes, default [1] = pytest test failure). argv is a list (no shell); '{python}' expands to the current interpreter. id must match [a-z0-9][a-z0-9._-]*. After the fix the same tests run as required checks 'regression:<id>' and must pass. If an automated failing-before-fix test is impractical set feasible=false and give infeasible_reason and alternative_strategy (>= 30 chars each); tests are then ignored.
